incident.title: Optional product-comparison panel fails in the customer portal
incident.alert_or_symptom: Some customers cannot open the optional product-comparison panel in the customer web portal, while product browsing, sign-in, basket and checkout functions remain available.

technical_evidence.observation: Fourteen customers reported that selecting Compare Products causes the comparison panel to remain blank. No reports indicate failure of product pages, sign-in, basket or checkout.
Affected browser sessions record an unhandled JavaScript TypeError in comparison-panel.js when the comparison panel attempts to render a product attribute whose display label is null.
Portal home-page loading, product search, product-detail viewing, sign-in, basket updates and checkout synthetic transactions all remained successful.
Customer Web Portal server error rates and Public API Gateway request outcomes remained within normal operating thresholds during the affected period.
The directly observed failure is confined to client-side comparison-panel rendering. No supporting service, platform or infrastructure failure has been identified.

service_impact.user_impact_description: Fourteen customers cannot use the optional product-comparison panel, while all core portal functions and customer purchasing journeys remain available.
service_impact.workaround_description: Customers can review product-detail pages individually and continue shopping without using the comparison panel.

environmental_context: The Customer Web Portal is a Tier 1 service, but the affected product-comparison panel is an optional convenience feature.
Product browsing, authentication, basket management, payment and checkout remain operational.
The comparison feature does not modify customer, product or transaction data.
reported_unknowns: The complete set of product records containing the null display label has not yet been established.
It is not known whether the defect affects any browser versions not represented in the current reports.
The time required to correct and release the client-side rendering defect is unknown.
additional_context: No data loss, corruption, security exposure or interruption to purchasing has been reported.
The issue can be reproduced without changing production data or configuration.
